description: Habit rules (packages/todo-core/src/habits.ts and habitGroups.ts), asserted by packages/todo-core/src/habitVectors.test.ts and crates/atlas-todo-rules/src/rules/vectors.rs. Days are local date keys: a habit's `created` stands for `created_at` at local noon of that day. To add a case, add its inputs and copy the values the TypeScript test reports into `expected`.

habits.name: daily: a skip bridges the streak, today still open
daily: a missed day breaks the streak, the best run is kept
daily on Mon/Wed/Fri: off days neither count nor break
daily on weekdays: a missed Wednesday
weekly 3x from Monday: met weeks, a short week after a skip, this week in progress
weekly 3x from Sunday: the same days redrawn into other weeks
weekly 2x: a week that fell short breaks the streak
every 3 days: blocks tiled from creation
every 2 days: a fully skipped block is dropped and bridged
a backfill before creation counts, and nothing recorded yet today
schedule history: daily, then weekdays, then weekly 2x (aligned to the next week)
schedule history: interval re-anchors at its own start

to_habit.name: a weekly target below 1 reads as 1

checkins.name: a row from before skip days

schedule_changes.name: the first change records the original schedule too
a second change the same day replaces that day's entry
flipping back the same day is a no-op
weekdays changed on a later day

groups.name: a daily and a weekly member
a member added later owes nothing before it existed
